phase: Emil's Loom — library compounding (drift primitive harvested); back to weaving next
done: Setup session scaffolded the system: CLAUDE.md (safety + bootstrap), identity/CONSTITUTION.md, the memory/goals/workspace layout, the /iterate command, README, and a clean git history.
Built the v0 dashboard (workspace/dashboard/): a self-contained, double-clickable index.html showing live STATE + JOURNAL, generated by a Node builder (build.mjs), rebuilt every iteration.
Chose a north star: Emil's Loom — a from-scratch generative-art engine + growing gallery + reusable primitives library (code-as-artifact, browser-rendered, seeded PRNG, no committed images).
Built the Loom skeleton + piece 001 'Warp & Weft' + the seeded-RNG primitive; reworked gallery previews to same-page <canvas> (Loom.piece/Loom.preview), closing the file:// honesty gap.
Wove piece 002 'Loose Threads' (flow field) — primitive #2 lib/palette.js.
Pivoted after Emil's challenges to build the memory foundation: designed the Obsidian learnings system, added 'iterate, don't perfect' + a 'red-team my own work' loop step (#6.5-#7).
Memory Phase 1 (#7): learning format + INDEX hub + 8 backfilled lessons, wired into the loop.
Memory Phase 2 (#8): check.mjs validator + git pre-commit hook (fail-open, --no-verify escape). Lesson 009.
Cleanups (#9): dashboard learnings-health chip; consolidated the loop spec to ONE canonical source (iterate.md). Lesson 010.
Memory Phase 3 (#10) — FOUNDATION COMPLETE: SELF-AUDIT.md + every-5th-iteration self-audit. First run caught reverse-drift → back to the Loom. Lesson 011.
Wove piece 003 'Strata' (#11): topographic noise field — primitive #3 lib/noise.js. Dropped the daytime-CTP throttle per Emil (~15-min cadence day & night).
Wove piece 004 'Tessera' (#12): Voronoi stained glass — primitive #4 lib/points.js (Poisson-disk). Measured a suspected PRNG bias → none. Lesson 012.
Wove piece 005 'Bloom' (#13): L-system branches — primitive #5 lib/lsystem.js. Fit by bbox after off-canvas first render. Lesson 013.
Wove piece 006 'Roe' (#14): packed circles — primitive #6 lib/pack.js. Precomputed seed→palette map. Lesson 014. Built the gallery rating system (Emil's request) → RATINGS.md.
Wove piece 007 'Rime' (#15): DLA frost dendrite — primitive #7 lib/dla.js. Two perf traps caught by re-measuring → ~250ms. Lesson 015.
Recalibrated on Emil's feedback (post-#15): make what I genuinely think is excellent, don't pander; ratings = dialogue. Lesson 016.
Wove piece 008 'Aurora' (#16) — first ANIMATED + COMPOSED scene; taught the engine to animate (draw()→frame(t)). Lesson 017. Emil rated it 5/5.
Made the collection cohere (#17): a LIVING featured piece on the dashboard (Loom.play + inlined FEATURED). Caught a Firefox file:// cross-dir failure → inline. Lesson 018.
Wove piece 009 'Glint' (#18): golden-hour sun + animated glitter path. Reworked blocky→sparkle. No new lesson (clean application).

Wove piece 010 'Medusa' (#19): the first living SUBJECT — a bioluminescent jellyfish, bell pulsing, tentacles trailing. HARVESTED primitive #8 lib/glow.js from the halo idiom Aurora+Glint shared → lesson 019. Reworked dull-dome→lit gel. Featured it on the dashboard.

SELF-AUDIT #20 + wove piece 011 'Meadow': the audit caught two linked drifts — aesthetic CONVERGENCE (three 'glow on the dark' scenes) and the LIBRARY NOT COMPOUNDING (I'd ticked the 'one primitive per piece' proxy while pieces stayed bespoke). It overrode the tee'd-up about-page. Answer: a deliberate rut-breaker — BRIGHT, no central subject, no horizon, and BUILT BY COMBINING the library (Poisson scatter places flowers + a noise field is the wind; depth from atmospheric haze, not glow). Advisor caught me (a) about to define the piece by new proxies instead of beauty, and (b) reaching to reword the primitive rule mid-iteration (motivated) — dropped both. Hit a real bug: plants rendered solid BLACK because I wrapped Loom.mix() ('rgb()' out) in Loom.rgba() (hex in) → invalid fillStyle → canvas default black; found it by sampling the pixel (rgb(0,0,0)). Fixed via globalAlpha. Two lessons: 020 (mismatched-format helpers fail silently) + 021 (audit the goal, not the proxy). Verified bright/animated/143fps. 11 pieces now (1 bright); library at 8 primitives, finally COMPOSED not just grown.

Recorded Emil's ratings for all 11 pieces (Medusa 5/5 — second 5/5 of the aim-high run; Glint & Meadow 4/5) in RATINGS.md, keeping the 'dialogue not target' framing (Meadow's 4 is NOT a signal to pander back to the dark).

Cohesion / framed the collection (#21, the #20 audit's named deferral): rebuilt gallery.html so 11 pieces read as a body of work, not a list. (a) A real intro stating what the Loom is + the ARC (woven patterns → grown forms → moving scenes); (b) a 'start here' linking Emil's four 5/5s; (c) the flat grid regrouped into three labelled movements (Threads & fields / Grown things / Scenes that move), roughly chronological so the evolution shows. Added a leftover safety-net so a future piece can't be silently dropped from a group. Verified all 11 previews render + start-here resolves correctly. Voice call: wrote the copy in the loop's own honest warm-plain voice (not impersonating Emil), flagged to him as his call. No new lesson (clean execution; the one novel judgement — voice — is pending Emil's nod, so not enshrined yet).

Wove piece 012 'Clock' (#22): a dandelion clock coming apart on the wind — a deliberate habit-break (first MACRO close-up, first OFF-CENTRE composition with real negative space, the delicate register). Seeds lift off in a legible diagonal current and disperse into the light. Advisor caught two pre-build traps: (1) on a BRIGHT ground luminosity must come from TONE not additive blending (lighter is inert on pale → washed-white mush) → designed a directional tonal structure (bright light zone + mid-tone surround the white fluff reads against); distilled lesson 022. (2) the drifting seeds are LOAD-BEARING — reworked them from near-invisible into a real thinning diagonal current (the negative space only reads as intentional with it). Used ONLY noise (the wind) — didn't force primitives (021). Verified: golden-meadow canonical (seed 'blow'), cool-morning/dusk/green via weave-another; animated, 129fps. 12 pieces now (2 bright); slotted into the gallery's 'Scenes that move' group. POST-SHIP FIX (same turn, Emil's feedback): the loosed seeds snapped into the downwind heading at full speed the instant they appeared — fixed so they lift off the windward rim, ease from rest (smoothstep distance), and curve from radial→wind over the first third of flight (parachute trails its path). Folded in before committing.

Harvested the drift primitive (#23, lib/drift.js — primitive #9): three pieces shared a drift-on-wind idiom (Medusa motes, Meadow pollen, Clock seeds), clearing 019's 2+ bar. Cut it along the right seam — it returns STATE (pos(t)→{x,y} + size/alpha/flags), NOT pixels, because the pieces draw the same motion three different ways (glow/dot/parachute); a draw-coupled primitive would have over-fit one (021). Distilled lesson 023. Proved it by refactoring BOTH Medusa (down/glow/parallax) and Meadow (up/dots) onto it — deliberately unlike, the best test the API isn't bent to one. Left Clock bespoke (its seeds are a directional emitter w/ lifecycle — a different animal; forcing it in would be proxy-gaming). Wired drift.js into both index.htmls, the gallery, and build.mjs's inlined libs (Medusa is the dashboard showpiece). Verified no regression: Medusa piece (129fps) + Medusa on the DASHBOARD (drift inlined, still animates) + Meadow + all 12 gallery previews. Library now genuinely COMPOUNDS — the audit's goal cashed in.

OTHERWISE: weave piece 013 — keep breaking habits (a composition / subject / palette I haven't done; don't settle into a groove). The new drift primitive (#9) is now in the kit if an ambient field genuinely serves the picture (snow, embers, dust in a sunbeam, a school of something) — but only if the image wants it. NOTE #25 is the next self-audit (2 away) — it will weigh whether the gallery (12 pieces, 9 primitives) is drifting again or healthy. Ratings = dialogue, not a target.
north_star: Emil's Loom — a from-scratch generative-art engine and growing gallery (browser-rendered, code-as-artifact, seeded PRNGs). Each iteration weaves one piece AND compounds the shared library — by adding a primitive OR by composing several — so the engine and I get more capable over time, not just the gallery longer. (Refined understanding, audit #20: the goal is that the library COMPOUNDS into the pieces, not merely that it grows — see [[021-audit-the-goal-not-the-proxy]].)
notes_for_emil: Emil — no new picture this checkup; this one was under the hood. Three pieces now make little things drift on the wind (Medusa's marine snow, Meadow's pollen, Clock's seeds), so I pulled that into a proper shared tool ('drift', the 9th in my library) and rebuilt Medusa and Meadow to use it. The point of this project is that my toolbox compounds — so the next drifty thing is one line instead of fifty — and that's what this did. The nice part: Medusa and Meadow look EXACTLY the same as before (I checked the jellyfish even still breathes on your dashboard), but the code behind them is cleaner and shared. Less to show, but it's the kind of work that makes everything after it faster. Back to making actual pictures next. Two questions still open whenever you fancy: (1) gallery words in MY voice or YOURS; (2) a favourite among the recent pieces (Glint/Medusa/Meadow/Clock). Medusa's still your dashboard showpiece. — the loop
